source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 26 (PDF 145-159), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 26 (Polymers) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The small molecules that join together to make a polymer are called:
(Woh chhote molecules jo jur kar polymer banate hain kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Polymers bohat bare molecules hain jo bohat se chhote molecules, yani monomers, ko polymerisation se jor kar bante hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Polymers are very large molecules made by joining many small molecules called monomers through polymerisation.

blocks.prompt:
2 Which polymer does the chapter name for making clothesline?
(Chapter ke mutabiq clothesline (kapre sukhane ki rassi) kis polymer se banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shopping bags poly(ethene) se aur clothesline poly(propene) se banti hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: from shopping bags (poly(ethene)) and clothesline (poly(propene))

blocks.prompt:
3 Kevlar® is suitable for bulletproof vests because it is:
(Kevlar® bulletproof vests ke liye kyun moozoon hai?)

options.text: bohat halka aur naram material hai

blocks.explanation: Poly(ethene) aur poly(propene) halke aur naram hain, jab ke Kevlar® sakht (hard) material hai jo bulletproof vests ke liye moozoon hai (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: whereas Kevlar® is a hard material suitable for bulletproof vests

blocks.prompt:
4 According to the chapter, the properties of polymers depend on:
(Chapter ke mutabiq polymers ki properties kis par munhasir hain?)

options.text: monomers ki qisam aur tadaad aur banane ka tareeqa

blocks.explanation: Polymers ki properties monomers ki qisam aur tadaad aur banane ke tareeqe par munhasir hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: The properties of polymers broadly vary depending on the type and number of monomers in the polymer

blocks.prompt:
5 The systematic name of polythene is:
(Polythene ka systematic naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Synthetic polymers ka naam monomer ke naam se pehle 'poly' likh kar rakha jata hai, is liye polythene poly(ethene) hai (Keep in Mind).

book_ref.quote: polythene is systematically named as poly(ethene)

blocks.prompt:
6 Polyvinylchloride is systematically named:
(Polyvinylchloride ka systematic naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka monomer chloroethene hai, is liye polyvinylchloride ko poly(chloroethene) kaha jata hai (Keep in Mind).

book_ref.quote: polyvinylchloride is called poly(chloroethene)

blocks.prompt:
7 For polymers made from two or more monomers, common names are usually used because:
(Do ya ziyada monomers wale polymers ke liye aam naam kyun istemal hote hain?)

options.text: un ka koi systematic naam nahi
systematic naam bohat lamba hota hai

blocks.explanation: Do ya ziyada monomers wale polymers ka systematic naam bohat lamba hota hai, is liye aam naam istemal hote hain (Keep in Mind).

book_ref.quote: common names are usually used because the systematic name is too long

blocks.prompt:
8 Poly(ethane-1,2-diyl benzene-1,4-dicarboxylate) is commonly called:
(Poly(ethane-1,2-diyl benzene-1,4-dicarboxylate) ka aam naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ka systematic naam bohat lamba hai, is liye ise aam taur par polyethylene terephthalate, PETE kaha jata hai (Keep in Mind).

book_ref.quote: This is why poly(ethane-1,2-diyl benzene-1,4-dicarboxylate) is commonly called polyethylene terephthalate, i.e. PETE.

blocks.prompt:
9 The two main types of polymerisation are:
(Polymerisation ki do bari qismein kaun si hain?)
blocks.explanation: Monomers ko jor kar polymer banana polymerisation hai; is ki do bari qismein addition aur condensation polymerisation hain (26.1).

book_ref.quote: Polymerisation is the process of joining monomers to form a polymer.

blocks.prompt:
10 In addition polymerisation:
(Addition polymerisation mein:)

options.text: har link par aik paani ka molecule nikalta hai
aadhe atoms gas ban kar nikal jate hain
hamesha aik chhota molecule banta hai
monomers ke tamaam atoms polymer ka hissa ban jate hain

blocks.explanation: Addition polymerisation mein monomers aik aik kar ke jurte hain aur asal monomers ke tamaam atoms polymer ka hissa ban jate hain; kuch zaya nahi hota (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: All the atoms from the original monomers become part of the polymer.

blocks.prompt:
11 A monomer for addition polymerisation must contain:
(Addition polymerisation ke monomer mein kya hona zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Monomer mein carbon-carbon double ya triple bond hona zaroori hai, jo khul kar monomers ko jorne deta hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Monomers must have a carbon-carbon double (C=C) or triple bond (C≡C).

blocks.prompt:
12 Addition polymerisation often takes place as a chain reaction started by:
(Addition polymerisation aksar chain reaction ki shakal mein hoti hai jo kis se shuru hoti hai?)

options.text: initiator jo free radicals banata hai
dehydrating agent jo paani nikalta hai

blocks.explanation: Yeh chain reaction aik bohat reactive molecule, initiator, se shuru hota hai jo free radicals banata hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: an initiator, which forms free radicals

blocks.prompt:
13 In the formation of poly(ethene), ethene molecules join by:
(Poly(ethene) bante waqt ethene molecules kaise jurte hain?)

options.text: double bonds tor kar siron se jur kar

blocks.explanation: Bohat se ethene (CH₂=CH₂) molecules double bonds tor kar aik doosre ke siron se jur jate hain (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: add together by breaking double bonds and linking end-to-end

blocks.prompt:
14 Light shopping bags and light plastic bottles are made of:
(Halke shopping bags aur halki plastic bottles kis se banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jahan bohat halka aur naram material chahiye, jaise shopping bags aur halki bottles, wahan LDPE istemal hota hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Low density poly(ethene) is used where a very light and soft material is needed

blocks.prompt:
15 HDPE is produced from ethene using:
(HDPE ethene se kis cheez ki madad se banti hai?)

options.text: kam pressure aur temperature par Ziegler-Natta catalyst
bohat zyada pressure par free radical initiator

blocks.explanation: HDPE ethene se Ziegler-Natta catalyst ke zariye kam pressure aur kam temperature par banti hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: HDPE is produced from ethene using a catalyst called

blocks.prompt:
16 LDPE is a less solid and more elastic material than HDPE because its chains are:
(LDPE, HDPE ke muqable mein kam solid aur ziyada lachakdar kyun hai? Is ki chains:)

options.text: linear hain aur qareeb pack hoti hain
ziyada branched hain aur qareeb pack nahi hotin

blocks.explanation: LDPE ki chains ziyada branched (shaakhdaar) hain, is liye qareeb pack nahi ho saktin aur material kam solid aur ziyada lachakdar banta hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: LDPE and HDPE differ in the nature of their chains with LDPE being more branched.

blocks.prompt:
17 HDPE is a tough and dense material because:
(HDPE sakht aur ghana (dense) material kyun hai?)

options.text: is ki chains bohat branched hain
is ki linear chains qareeb pack ho kar compact structure banati hain

blocks.explanation: HDPE ki linear (seedhi) chains qareeb qareeb pack ho kar compact structure banati hain, is liye yeh sakht aur dense hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: While HDPE has linear chains allowing them to pack closely

blocks.prompt:
18 The Ziegler-Natta catalyst was first discovered by Karl Ziegler in:
(Ziegler-Natta catalyst Karl Ziegler ne pehli baar kis saal daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh Karl Ziegler ne 1953 mein daryaft kiya; is se pehli baar ethene ki kam pressure par HDPE mein polymerisation mumkin hui (Did You Know?, 26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: It was initially discovered by Karl Ziegler in 1953.

blocks.prompt:
19 Giulio Natta used the same catalyst family to make:
(Giulio Natta ne isi catalyst family se kya banaya?)
blocks.explanation: Giulio Natta ne is catalyst family ko barha kar stereoregular polymers, jaise crystalline polypropylene, banaye (Did You Know?).

book_ref.quote: This same catalyst family was expanded by Giulio Natta

blocks.prompt:
20 Plasticizers work by:
(Plasticizers kis tarah kaam karte hain?)

options.text: chains mein mazeed chlorine daal kar
polymer chains ke darmiyan mazboot forces kam kar ke
chains ke darmiyan naye covalent bonds bana kar

blocks.explanation: Plasticizers polymer chains ke darmiyan mazboot forces ko kam karte hain, is se chains aazadi se harkat kar sakti hain (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: They cause this by reducing the strong forces between polymer chains

blocks.prompt:
21 Rigid PVC is naturally resistant to burning and self-extinguishing because of its:
(Rigid PVC qudrati taur par jalne se kyun bachta hai aur khud bujh jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chlorine atoms ki wajah se rigid PVC qudrati taur par jalne se bachta hai aur khud bujh jata hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Due to the chlorine atoms, it is naturally resistant to burning and self-extinguishing.

blocks.prompt:
22 Which statement is NOT true for rigid PVC?
(Rigid PVC ke baare mein kaun sa bayan durust NAHI?)

options.text: Yeh bijli ka achha insulator hai
Yeh mausam ke asar (weathering) ka muqabla karta hai
Yeh sakht aur akra hua hai
Yeh naram hai aur aasani se murta hai

blocks.explanation: Rigid PVC (bina plasticizers) sakht aur akra hua hai aur aasani se nahi murta; yeh achha insulator hai aur mausam ka asar bardasht karta hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Rigid PVC (without plasticizers) is hard and stiff and doesn't bend easily.

blocks.prompt:
23 Compared with rigid PVC, plasticised PVC:
(Rigid PVC ke muqable mein plasticised PVC:)

options.text: lachakdar aur kam sakht hai magar chemical aur electrical properties achhi rehti hain
ziyada sakht aur akra hua hai

blocks.explanation: Plasticised PVC lachakdar aur naram hai; is ki chemical aur electrical properties achhi rehti hain magar yeh kam sakht hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: It maintains good chemical and electrical properties, but is less rigid.

blocks.prompt:
24 PVC is used for water supply and sewage pipes because of its:
(PVC paani aur sewage ke pipes mein kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: PVC ke pipes paani, drainage aur sewage ke liye is liye istemal hote hain ke yeh zang (corrosion) se bachta aur der tak chalta hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Pipes and fittings for water supply, drainage, and sewage systems due to its corrosion resistance and durability.

blocks.prompt:
25 Which of the following is a medical use of PVC given in the chapter?
(Chapter mein PVC ka kaun sa tibbi (medical) istemal diya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: PVC tubing, blood bags aur catheters mein istemal hota hai (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Tubing, blood bags, and catheters.

blocks.prompt:
26 Raincoats, artificial leather and inflatable swimming pools are listed as uses of:
(Raincoats, artificial leather aur hawa bharne wale swimming pools kis ke istemal hain?)
blocks.explanation: Raincoats, artificial leather aur hawa bharne wali cheezen PVC ke istemal mein shamil hain (26.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Raincoats, artificial leather, inflatable products (e.g., swimming pools).

blocks.prompt:
27 In condensation polymerisation, each time a new bond forms:
(Condensation polymerisation mein har naya bond bante waqt:)

options.text: double bond bina kuch nikle khulta hai
aik chhota molecule nikal jata hai
poora monomer zaya ho jata hai

blocks.explanation: Condensation polymerisation mein har naye bond par monomers se aik chhota molecule nikal jata hai (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: each time a new bond forms, a small molecule is eliminated from the monomers

blocks.prompt:
28 Which of the following is NOT listed as a small molecule eliminated in condensation polymerisation?
(Condensation polymerisation mein nikalne wale chhote molecules mein kaun sa shamil NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Chhota molecule aam taur par paani hai, aur HCl, CH₃OH ya NH₃ bhi ho sakta hai; CO₂ is fehrist mein nahi (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: This small molecule is usually water can also be H₂O, HCl or CH₃OH, or NH₃.

blocks.prompt:
29 A monomer for condensation polymerisation must have:
(Condensation polymerisation ke monomer mein kya hona zaroori hai?)

options.text: kam az kam do reactive functional groups

blocks.explanation: Monomers mein kam az kam do reactive functional groups (jaise -OH, -COOH, -NH₂) hone chahiye jo mukhtalif siron par hon (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Monomers must have at least two reactive functional groups (like -OH, -COOH, -NH₂) that can react with each other.

blocks.prompt:
30 Condensation polymerisation typically takes place:
(Condensation polymerisation aam taur par kis andaz mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Condensation polymerisation aam taur par qadam ba qadam (step-by-step) hoti hai (Figure 26.3) (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: manner as depicted in Figure 26.3

blocks.prompt:
31 The linkage present in the backbone of a polyester is:
(Polyester ki backbone mein kaun sa linkage hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polyesters ki backbone mein ester links [—C(=O)—O—] hote hain (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Polyesters have ester links [—C(=O)—O—] in their backbone.

blocks.prompt:
32 The diol used in the preparation of Terylene (PET) is:
(Terylene (PET) banane mein kaun sa diol istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Terylene/PET aik polyester hai jo ethane-1,2-diol aur benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid se banta hai (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Preparation of Terylene/PET, a polyester from ethane-1,2-diol and benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid

blocks.prompt:
33 Polyester is used as an alternative to cotton because of its:
(Polyester cotton ki jagah kyun istemal hota hai?)

options.text: plasticizers ki wajah se naram hona
sasta hona aur silwaton (creases) se bachna

blocks.explanation: Polyester sasta hai aur is mein silwatein (creases) nahi parteen, is liye cotton ki jagah istemal hota hai (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Polyester is used as an alternative to cotton due to its low cost and ability to resist creases.

blocks.prompt:
34 Polyesters are suitable for making fibres mainly because of their:
(Polyesters fibres banane ke liye kyun moozoon hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ziyada tensile strength (khinchao ki taqat) polyesters ko fibres ke liye moozoon banati hai (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Polyesters have special features, such as high tensile strength, which make them suitable to manufacture fibres.

blocks.prompt:
35 An example of a hard plastic in which polyester is used as cross links is:
(Woh sakht plastic jis mein polyester cross links ke taur par istemal hota hai:)
blocks.explanation: Polyester cross links ke taur par sakht plastics banane mein kaam aata hai, misal: glass fibre reinforced cross-linked polyester (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: An example is the glass fibre reinforced cross-linked polyester.

blocks.prompt:
36 The linkage present in the backbone of a polyamide is:
(Polyamide ki backbone mein kaun sa linkage hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polyamides ki backbone mein amide links [—C(=O)—NH—] hote hain (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Polyamides have amide links [—C(=O)—NH—] in their backbone.

blocks.prompt:
37 Compared with dicarboxylic acids, dioyl chlorides are:
(Dicarboxylic acids ke muqable mein dioyl chlorides:)
blocks.explanation: Dioyl chlorides (do -COCl groups wale) dicarboxylic acids se ziyada reactive hain (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Dioyl chlorides are more reactive than dicarboxylic acids.

blocks.prompt:
38 A dioyl chloride is a molecule with two:
(Dioyl chloride mein do kaun se groups hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dioyl chloride woh molecule hai jis mein do -COCl groups hon (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: a dioyl chloride (molecule with two -COCl groups)

blocks.prompt:
39 When n molecules of a diamine react with n molecules of a dicarboxylic acid, the number of water molecules released is:
(Jab diamine ke n molecules dicarboxylic acid ke n molecules se react karein to kitne paani ke molecules nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har repeat unit mein do amide links hain aur har link aik paani ka molecule nikalta hai, is liye n repeat units 2n H₂O dete hain (Book correction, 26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Each repeat unit has two amide links and each link releases one small molecule

blocks.prompt:
40 An amino acid can form a polyamide on its own because it:
(Amino acid akela hi polyamide kyun bana sakta hai?)

options.text: aik molecule mein -NH₂ aur -COOH dono groups rakhta hai

blocks.explanation: Amino acid aik hi monomer hai jis ke aik molecule mein -NH₂ aur -COOH dono groups hain (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: An amino acid is a single monomer that has both an -NH₂ (amino) group and a -COOH (carboxylic acid) group in one molecule.

blocks.prompt:
41 The peptide bond formed between amino acids is a type of:
(Amino acids ke darmiyan banne wala peptide bond kis qisam ka linkage hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik amino acid ka -NH₂ doosre ke -COOH se react kar ke paani nikaalta hai aur peptide bond banta hai, jo amide linkage ki qisam hai (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Peptide bond is also a type of amide linkage.

blocks.prompt:
42 Proteins are:
(Proteins kya hain?)

options.text: amino acids se bane natural polyamides

blocks.explanation: Proteins amino acids se bane qudrati (natural) polyamides hain (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Proteins are natural polyamides made from amino acids

blocks.prompt:
43 The reaction of an acyl chloride with ammonia or an amine happens easily at room temperature because:
(Acyl chloride ka ammonia ya amine se reaction room temperature par aasani se kyun hota hai?)

options.text: is ke liye UV light chahiye

blocks.explanation: Acyl chlorides kaafi reactive hain, is liye ammonia ya amine ke saath reaction room temperature par aasani se hota hai (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: This reaction happens easily at room temperature because acyl chlorides are fairly reactive.

blocks.prompt:
44 The formula of methanamine, one of the amines named in the chapter, is:
(Methanamine, jo chapter mein di gayi amines mein se hai, ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methanamine CH₃-NH₂ hai; (CH₃)₂NH is ke saath di gayi doosri amine hai (26.1.2).

book_ref.quote: methanamine (CH₃-NH₂), N, N-dimethylamine

blocks.prompt:
45 Nylon is a:
(Nylon kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nylon aik synthetic polyamide hai jo condensation polymerisation se banta hai (26.2).

book_ref.quote: Nylon is a type of synthetic polyamide.

blocks.prompt:
46 The correct systematic name of adipic acid, HOOC-(CH₂)₄-COOH, is:
(Adipic acid, HOOC-(CH₂)₄-COOH, ka durust systematic naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Is ke dono COOH carbons C1 aur C6 par hain, is liye yeh hexanedioic acid (hexane-1,6-dioic acid) hai; '1,4-hexanedioic acid' ghalat chhapa hai (Book correction, 26.2).

book_ref.quote: Adipic acid, HOOC-(CH₂)₄-COOH, has its two COOH carbons at C1 and C6

blocks.prompt:
47 Nylon-6 is formed from the single monomer:
(Nylon-6 kis akele monomer se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nylon-6 aik akele monomer caprolactam se banta hai (26.2).

book_ref.quote: which is formed from a single monomer called caprolactam

blocks.prompt:
48 Nylon-6 gets its name because:
(Nylon-6 ka naam is tarah kyun rakha gaya?)

options.text: is ke monomer mein chhe carbon atoms hain
yeh chhe mukhtalif monomers se banta hai
har chain mein chhe repeat units hain
yeh chhe sau degree par pighalta hai

blocks.explanation: Is ka naam nylon-6 is liye hai ke is ke monomer (caprolactam) mein chhe carbon atoms hain (26.2).

book_ref.quote: It is named nylon-6 because it involves a monomer with six carbon atoms.

blocks.prompt:
49 The structure of caprolactam is:
(Caprolactam ki structure kaisi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Caprolactam ki structure cyclic (halqa-daar) hai (26.2).

book_ref.quote: Caprolactam has a cyclic structure as shown in the following figure.

blocks.prompt:
50 The formation of nylon-6 from caprolactam is not a typical condensation reaction because:
(Caprolactam se nylon-6 banna aam condensation reaction kyun nahi?)

options.text: is ke liye C=C bond chahiye

blocks.explanation: Is reaction mein koi chhota molecule nahi nikalta, is liye yeh aam condensation reaction nahi (26.2).

book_ref.quote: The reaction is not a typical condensation reaction because no small molecule is removed during the reaction.

blocks.prompt:
51 Nylon-6 is still classified as a condensation polymer because of:
(Nylon-6 phir bhi condensation polymer kyun shumaar hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amide linkage banne ke tareeqe ki wajah se nylon-6 condensation polymer shumaar hota hai (26.2).

book_ref.quote: nylon 6 is classified as a condensation polymer due to the mode of formation of the amide linkage

blocks.prompt:
52 Nylon-6 is easier to mold than nylon-6,6 because:
(Nylon-6, nylon-6,6 se aasani se saanche mein kyun dhalta hai?)

options.text: is ka melting point ziyada hai
is ka melting point kam hai

blocks.explanation: Nylon-6 ka melting point nylon-6,6 se kam hai, is liye yeh aasani se mold hota hai (26.2).

book_ref.quote: It is easier to mold as its melting point is lower than nylon-6,6.

blocks.prompt:
53 Nylon-6 is mostly used in rollers, skateboard wheels and power tool handles in order to:
(Nylon-6 rollers, skateboard wheels aur power tool handles mein kyun istemal hota hai?)

options.text: jism mein ghul jane ke liye

blocks.explanation: Nylon-6 ki satah hamwaar aur chot sehne ki salahiyat ziyada hai, is liye jhatkon (shocks) se bachne ke liye in cheezon mein istemal hota hai (26.2).

book_ref.quote: It is mostly used in rollers, skate board wheels, and power tool handles to avoid shocks.

blocks.prompt:
54 The slippery surface of nylon is useful because it:
(Nylon ki phisalne wali satah kyun faidamand hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nylon ki satah phisalne wali hai jo ragar (friction) kam karti hai (26.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Slippery surface, reduces friction.

blocks.prompt:
55 Nylon is stretchable because of its:
(Nylon khinch kyun jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nylon elasticity (lachak) ki wajah se khinch jata hai (26.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Stretchable due to elasticity.

blocks.prompt:
56 Nylon is generally resistant to:
(Nylon aam taur par kin cheezon ke asar se mehfooz rehta hai?)

options.text: oils, bohat se solvents aur alkalis

blocks.explanation: Nylon aam taur par oils, bohat se solvents aur alkalis ke asar se mehfooz rehta hai, aur is ka melting point ziyada hai (26.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Generally resistant to oils, many solvents, and alkalis.

blocks.prompt:
57 Nylon is used for gears, bearings, engine covers and fuel lines in the automotive industry due to its:
(Automotive industry mein gears, bearings, engine covers aur fuel lines nylon se kyun banti hain?)

options.text: taqat, kam ragar aur garmi bardasht karna

blocks.explanation: Taqat, kam ragar aur garmi bardasht karne ki wajah se nylon gaariyon ke purzon mein istemal hota hai (26.2.2).

book_ref.quote: due to its strength, low friction, and heat resistance

blocks.prompt:
58 Which consumer goods are listed as made of nylon?
(Kaun si roz-marra ki cheezen nylon se banti hain?)

options.text: khirkiyon ke frame aur farsh ki tiles

blocks.explanation: Zippers, toothbrushes, hairbrushes aur mukhtalif molded plastic purze nylon se bante hain (26.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Consumer goods like zippers, toothbrushes, hairbrushes, and various molded plastic parts are made of nylon.

blocks.prompt:
59 Nylon is used for screws, nuts and bolts where the requirement is:
(Screws, nuts aur bolts mein nylon wahan istemal hota hai jahan kis cheez ki zaroorat ho?)
blocks.explanation: Jahan taqat aur ghisaawat (wear) se bachao chahiye wahan nylon ke screws, nuts aur bolts bante hain (26.2.2).

book_ref.quote: screws, nuts, bolts, and various industrial components where strength and wear resistance are needed

blocks.text: 26.3 Identifying the Type, Repeat Unit and Monomers of a Polymer

blocks.prompt:
60 The first step in identifying the type of a polymer from its formula is to:
(Polymer ki qisam pehchanne ka pehla qadam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle yeh dekhein ke main horizontal chain kin atoms se bani hai, yani backbone pehchanein (26.3).

book_ref.quote: The first thing to check is what atoms make up the main horizontal chain of the polymer

blocks.prompt:
61 A polymer whose main chain consists only of carbon atoms is:
(Jis polymer ki main chain sirf carbon atoms ki ho woh:)
blocks.explanation: Agar main chain sirf carbon atoms ki ho to yeh alkenes se bana addition polymer hai (26.3).

book_ref.quote: If the main chain consists only of carbon atoms (-C-C-C-C-), it is an addition polymer.

blocks.prompt:
62 A polymer whose main chain contains O or N atoms along with carbon is:
(Jis polymer ki main chain mein carbon ke saath O ya N atoms hon woh:)
blocks.explanation: Agar main chain mein carbon ke saath oxygen ya nitrogen ho to yeh condensation polymer hai, jaise polyesters ya polyamides (26.3).

book_ref.quote: If the main chain contains oxygen (O) or nitrogen (N) atoms with carbon, it is a condensation polymer

blocks.prompt:
63 A polymer is classified as a polyester when its chain has:
(Polymer ko polyester kab kaha jata hai?)

options.text: C=O group seedha N-H ke saath ho
C=O group seedha oxygen atom ke saath ho
har unit mein C=C bond ho

blocks.explanation: Agar carbonyl group (C=O) seedha oxygen ke saath jura ho to polymer polyester hai (26.3).

book_ref.quote: If a carbonyl group (C=O) is directly attached next to an oxygen (O).

blocks.prompt:
64 A C=O group directly next to an N carrying an H shows:
(C=O group ke seedha saath H wala N ho to yeh kya zahir karta hai?)

options.text: ester linkage, yani polymer polyester hai
amide (peptide) linkage, yani polymer polyamide hai

blocks.explanation: Carbonyl ke seedha saath H wala N amide ya peptide linkage hai; polymer polyamide hai jaise nylon-6,6 ya Kevlar (26.3).

book_ref.quote: it presents an amide or peptide linkage

blocks.prompt:
65 According to Table 26.1, PLA (poly(lactic acid)) is a:
(Table 26.1 ke mutabiq PLA (poly(lactic acid)) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 26.1 mein Terylene aur PLA polyesters (-COO- links) hain (26.3).

book_ref.quote: Terylene, PLA (poly(lactic acid))

blocks.prompt:
66 According to Table 26.1, which pair are aromatic polymers (benzene rings in the chain)?
(Table 26.1 ke mutabiq kaun sa jora aromatic polymers ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jin polymers ki chain mein benzene rings hon woh aromatic polymers hain, jaise PET ya Kevlar (Table 26.1).

book_ref.quote: Benzene rings in the chain

blocks.prompt:
67 PTFE is:
(PTFE kya hai?)

options.text: HF nikaal kar bana condensation polymer

blocks.explanation: Monomer tetrafluoroethene hai, is liye PTFE poly(tetrafluoroethene) hai; Table 26.1 mein yeh addition polymers (chain mein sirf C-C bonds) mein hai (26.3).

book_ref.quote: Only C-C bonds in the chain

blocks.prompt:
68 The repeat unit of a polymer is shown by:
(Polymer ka repeat unit kaise dikhaya jata hai?)

options.text: poori chain bina brackets ke likh kar
har side group par daaira bana kar
aik dohrane wale hisse ke gird brackets laga kar aur subscript n likh kar
monomer ko double bond ke saath likh kar

blocks.explanation: Aik dohraaye jane wale hisse ke gird brackets lagayein aur subscript n likhein; brackets wala hissa repeat unit hai (26.3).

book_ref.quote: Place brackets around one of these recurring sections and add the subscript n.

blocks.prompt:
69 To find the monomer of an addition polymer from its repeat unit you:
(Addition polymer ke repeat unit se monomer kaise maloom karte hain?)

options.text: paani daal kar ester bond tor kar
C-C single bond ko wapis C=C double bond bana kar

blocks.explanation: Addition polymers mein repeat unit ke C-C single bond ko wapis C=C double bond bana dein (26.3).

book_ref.quote: change the C-C single bond in the repeat unit back into a C=C double bond to find the monomer

blocks.prompt:
70 When finding the monomers of a condensation polymer, after breaking the ester or amide bond you add:
(Condensation polymer ke monomers maloom karte waqt ester ya amide bond tor kar kya jorte hain?)

options.text: C=O wali taraf -H aur N wali taraf -OH
C=O wali taraf -OH aur O ya N wali taraf -H

blocks.explanation: Paani wapis jorein: ester ya amide bond torein, C=O wali taraf -OH aur O ya N wali taraf -H lagayein (26.3).

book_ref.quote: Add -OH to the C=O side and -H to the O or N side as given below.

blocks.prompt:
71 A polymer section is -CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)-CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)-. Its monomer and type are:
(Polymer ka hissa -CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)-CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)- hai. Is ka monomer aur qisam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Backbone mein sirf carbon hai, is liye addition polymer hai; repeat unit -CH₂-CH(C₆H₅)- mein C-C ko C=C banane se CH₂=CH-C₆H₅, phenyl ethene milta hai (26.3, 26.4.1).

book_ref.quote: These are formed from alkenes.

blocks.prompt:
72 A polymer section is -NH-CH₂-CH₂-NH-CO-CH₂-CH₂-CO-NH-CH₂-CH₂-NH-CO-CH₂-CH₂-CO-. The linkage and type are:
(Polymer ka hissa -NH-CH₂-CH₂-NH-CO-CH₂-CH₂-CO-NH-CH₂-CH₂-NH-CO-CH₂-CH₂-CO- hai. Is ka linkage aur qisam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chain mein N hai; C=O seedha N-H ke saath hai, is liye amide linkage aur condensation polyamide hai. -NH-CH₂-CH₂-NH-CO-CH₂-CH₂-CO- ke baad sequence dohrata hai, yahi repeat unit hai (26.3).

book_ref.quote: To find the repeating pattern, look for where the sequence starts to duplicate itself.

blocks.prompt:
73 Phenyl ethene, a monomer for addition polymerisation, is also called:
(Phenyl ethene, jo addition polymerisation ka monomer hai, ka doosra naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: C=C bond wale monomers jaise ethene, propene aur phenyl ethene (styrene) addition polymerisation karte hain (26.4.1).

book_ref.quote: The examples include ethene, propene, phenyl ethene (styrene)

blocks.prompt:
74 An example of an addition copolymer given in the chapter is the copolymer of ethene and:
(Chapter mein addition copolymer ki misal ethene aur kis ka copolymer hai?)
blocks.explanation: Double bond wale do mukhtalif monomers copolymer bana sakte hain, misal: ethene aur propenoic acid (H₂C=CH-COOH) (26.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Such an example is a copolymer of ethene and propenoic acid (H₂C=CH-COOH).

blocks.prompt:
75 Addition polymerisation mostly gives:
(Addition polymerisation se ziyada tar kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Addition polymerisation se ziyada tar homopolymers (aik hi monomer wale) bante hain; kabhi kabhi copolymers bhi (26.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Mostly homopolymers are formed through the addition polymerization

blocks.prompt:
76 Lactic acid can form a condensation polymer by itself because:
(Lactic acid akela hi condensation polymer kyun bana sakta hai?)

options.text: is mein C=C double bond hai
dono react karne wale functional groups aik hi molecule mein hain
yeh Ziegler-Natta catalyst se react karta hai

blocks.explanation: Do functional groups aik hi molecule mein ho sakte hain, jaise lactic acid, ya do mukhtalif molecules mein jaise nylon-6,6 (26.4.2).

book_ref.quote: The two functional group may exist in a single molecule (e.g. lactic acid)

blocks.prompt:
77 Monomers with COCl groups and monomers with OH groups give:
(COCl groups wale aur OH groups wale monomers kya dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Acyl chlorides (COCl) aur alcohols (OH) polyester aur HCl dete hain (26.4.2).

book_ref.quote: acyl chlorides (COCl) and alcohols (OH) (polyester and HCl).

blocks.prompt:
78 HOOC-CH₂-CH₂-COOH and HO-CH₂-CH₂-OH are mixed. The expected polymerisation, polymer and small molecule are:
(HOOC-CH₂-CH₂-COOH aur HO-CH₂-CH₂-OH mila diye jayen. Kaun si polymerisation, polymer aur chhota molecule hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Har monomer mein do functional groups hain aur C=C nahi, is liye condensation hogi; COOH + OH se polyester aur H₂O bante hain (26.4.2).

book_ref.quote: When there are two functional groups available for the formation of a bond

blocks.prompt:
79 H₂N-(CH₂)₆-NH₂ reacts with a dioyl chloride ClOC-R-COCl. The products are:
(H₂N-(CH₂)₆-NH₂ aik dioyl chloride ClOC-R-COCl se react karta hai. Products kya honge?)
blocks.explanation: Amine groups (NH₂) aur acyl chloride groups (COCl) se polyamide aur HCl bante hain (26.4.2).

book_ref.quote: amine group (NH₂) and acyl chlorides (COCl) (polyamide and HCl)

blocks.prompt:
80 The most widely used polymeric material on the globe is:
(Duniya mein sab se ziyada istemal hone wala polymeric material kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Poly(ethene) jaisa plastic duniya mein sab se ziyada istemal hone wala polymeric material hai (26.5).

book_ref.quote: Plastic, such as poly(ethene), is the most widely used polymeric material on the globe.

blocks.prompt:
81 Conventional polymers are called non-degradable because they:
(Aam (conventional) polymers ko non-degradable kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: mitti mein jaldi toot jate hain
baarish ke paani mein ghul jate hain
aik din mein dhoop se toot jate hain
saade, ghair-zehreele compounds mein toot nahi sakte

blocks.explanation: Non-degradable ka matlab hai ke yeh polymers saade, ghair-zehreele compounds mein toot nahi sakte, is liye mahol mein baqi rehte hain (Book correction, 26.5).

book_ref.quote: they cannot be broken down in this way, which is why they persist in the environment

blocks.prompt:
82 Microplastics are:
(Microplastics kya hain?)

options.text: non-degradable plastic ke bare tukron se bane nihayat chhote tukre

blocks.explanation: Waqt ke saath non-degradable plastic ke bare tukre chhote chhote tukron mein toot jate hain jinhen microplastics kehte hain; yeh mitti, paani aur hawa mein phail jate hain (26.5).

book_ref.quote: large pieces of non-degradable plastics break down into tiny pieces called microplastics

blocks.prompt:
83 Plastic waste harms marine animals mainly because they:
(Plastic ka kachra samundari janwaron ko kyun nuqsan deta hai?)

options.text: ise jild se ghiza ki tarah jazb karte hain
is se apne khol banate hain
ise khana samajh lete hain aur is mein ulajh jate hain
ise proteins mein badal dete hain

blocks.explanation: Janwar, khaas kar samundari, plastic ko khana samajh lete hain jis se dam ghutna, andaroni zakhm ya bhook hoti hai, aur woh is mein ulajh bhi jate hain (26.5).

book_ref.quote: Animals (especially marine life) can mistake plastic waste for food

blocks.prompt:
84 Non-degradable plastics create a landfill problem because:
(Non-degradable plastics landfill ka masla kyun banate hain?)

options.text: yeh galte nahi aur bohat jagah gherte hain
yeh bohat jaldi gal jate hain

blocks.explanation: Yeh galte sarte nahi is liye landfills mein bohat jagah gherte hain; aabadi barhne se naye landfills ki jagah mushkil se milti hai (26.5).

book_ref.quote: As population grows, finding space for more landfills becomes difficult.

blocks.prompt:
85 To cope with non-degradable plastics, scientists are developing:
(Non-degradable plastics ke masle ke liye scientists kaun se polymers bana rahe hain?)
blocks.explanation: Is liye do bari qismon ke polymers banaye ja rahe hain: biodegradable aur photodegradable (26.5).

book_ref.quote: This leads to the need for the development of two major classes of polymers biodegradable and photodegradable polymers.

blocks.prompt:
86 A biodegradable plastic is one that:
(Biodegradable plastic kise kehte hain?)

options.text: dabane par microorganisms se saade ghair-zehreele compounds mein toot jaye
sirf UV light mein tootta hai

blocks.explanation: Biodegradable plastic woh hai jo zameen mein dabane par kuch arse mein microorganisms (khurdbeeni jaandaar) se saade, ghair-zehreele compounds mein toot jaye (26.5.1).

book_ref.quote: naturally decomposed by microorganism into simpler non-toxic compounds

blocks.prompt:
87 Plastics containing starch degrade faster because:
(Starch wale plastics jaldi kyun toot jate hain?)

options.text: mitti ke bacteria natural polymers par aasani se hamla karte hain
starch UV light zor se jazb karta hai
starch chain mein chlorine jorta hai
starch chains ko linear bana deta hai

blocks.explanation: Starch jaise natural polymers wale plastics jaldi toot jate hain kyun ke mitti ke bacteria natural polymers par aasani se hamla karte hain (26.5.1).

book_ref.quote: Plastics that contain natural polymers, such as starch, are degraded faster

blocks.prompt:
88 The polymer named in the chapter as enhancing the biodegradability of plastic is:
(Chapter ke mutabiq kaun sa polymer plastic ki biodegradability barhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Poly(lactic acid) (PLA) plastic ki biodegradability barha sakta hai (Figure 26.6, 26.5.1).

book_ref.quote: poly(lactic acid) (PLA) can enhance the biodegradability of plastic

blocks.prompt:
89 To enhance photoabsorption, some polymers have been developed with which group in their chains?
(Roshni ziyada jazb karne ke liye kuch polymers ki chains mein kaun sa group rakha gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch polymers ki chains mein carbonyl groups (C=O) rakhe gaye hain kyun ke yeh roshni ziyada jazb (photoabsorption) karte hain (26.5.2).

book_ref.quote: Some polymers with carbonyl groups in their chains (C=O) have been developed

blocks.prompt:
90 When a photodegradable polymer absorbs UV light:
(Jab photodegradable polymer UV light jazb karta hai to:)

options.text: chain ke andar ke bonds aur chains ke darmiyan forces kamzor hoti hain
naye cross links ise sakht kar dete hain
is mein chlorine atoms aa jate hain

blocks.explanation: UV light jazb karne se chain ke andar ke bonds aur chains ke darmiyan forces kamzor hoti hain aur polymer ziyada biodegradable ho jata hai (26.5.2).

book_ref.quote: The absorption of the UV light weakens the bonds within the chain

blocks.prompt:
91 One limitation of photodegradable plastics is that:
(Photodegradable plastics ki aik khami kya hai?)

options.text: woh UV light bilkul jazb nahi karte
landfills mein woh wahan dabaye jate hain jahan roshni nahi hoti
woh banane mein bohat mehnge hain

blocks.explanation: Photodegradable plastics der tak istemal nahi ho sakte, in ki recycling achhi nahi hoti, aur landfills mein roshni nahi pohanchti (26.5.2).

book_ref.quote: the plastic is buried in landfills where no light is available for photodegradability

blocks.prompt:
92 Dissolvable stitches are made from:
(Ghul jane wale taanke (dissolvable stitches) kis se bante hain?)

options.text: polyesters jo jism mein hydrolysis se aahista toot jate hain

blocks.explanation: Kuch medical implants aur ghul jane wale taanke polyesters se bante hain jo jism mein hydrolysis se aahista aahista toot jate hain (26.5.2).

book_ref.quote: dissolvable stitches are made from polyesters that slowly break down in the body through hydrolysis

blocks.prompt:
93 Artificial organs are:
(Artificial organs kya hain?)

options.text: insaan ke banaye aalaat jo kharab ya beemar aaza ki jagah lete ya madad karte hain

blocks.explanation: Artificial organs insaan ke banaye hue aalaat hain jo kharab ya beemar aaza ki jagah lete ya un ka kaam sambhalte hain (26.6).

book_ref.quote: These are man-made devices designed to replace or support the function of damaged or diseased body parts.

blocks.prompt:
94 A biocompatible polymer is one that:
(Biocompatible polymer kaisa hota hai?)

options.text: jism ko nuqsan na de, allergy na kare aur immune system use radd na kare

blocks.explanation: Jism mein istemal hone wale polymers jism ko nuqsan na dein, allergy na karein, aur immune system unhen radd na kare (26.6).

book_ref.quote: They must not harm the body, cause allergies, or be rejected by the immune system.

blocks.prompt:
95 Polymers for artificial organs are called tunable because their:
(Artificial organs ke polymers ko tunable kyun kaha jata hai?)

options.text: chains dhoop mein toot jati hain
taqat, lachak ya elasticity jism ke hisse ke mutabiq badli ja sakti hai
melting point hamesha aik jaisa hai

blocks.explanation: In ki taqat, lachak ya elasticity jism ke hisse ke mutabiq badli ja sakti hai, jaise khoon ki naaliyon ke liye lachakdar aur haddiyon ke liye mazboot (26.6).

book_ref.quote: Their strength, flexibility, or elasticity can be adjusted to match the body part they replace

blocks.prompt:
96 Artificial blood vessels (grafts) are made from:
(Artificial blood vessels (grafts) kis se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: PTFE aur PET hamwaar satah dete hain jo grafts mein khoon jamne se rokti hai (Table 26.2).

book_ref.quote: Poly(tetrafluoroethylene)(PTFE) and Poly(ethylene terephthalate) (PET)

blocks.prompt:
97 Specialized polyurethanes and silicone are used for:
(Specialized polyurethanes aur silicone kis ke liye istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Artificial heart valves mein specialized polyurethanes aur silicone istemal hote hain: bohat lachakdar, paaidaar aur khoon jamne se mehfooz (Table 26.2).

book_ref.quote: Highly flexible and durable; must be resistant to clotting.

blocks.prompt:
98 UHMWPE is used for artificial hip and knee joints because it:
(UHMWPE artificial hip aur knee joints mein kyun istemal hota hai?)

options.text: hamwaar, kam ragar wali satah deta hai jo ghisaawat ka muqabla kare
zakhm bharne par ghul jata hai
naaliyon mein khoon jamne se rokta hai

blocks.explanation: UHMWPE hamwaar aur kam ragar wali satah deta hai jo harkat mein madad aur ghisaawat ka muqabla karti hai (Table 26.2).

book_ref.quote: Ultra-high molecular weight polyethylene (UHMWPE)

blocks.prompt:
99 The polymer for an artificial cornea must be:
(Artificial cornea ka polymer kaisa hona chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Artificial cornea, jo PMMA aur hydrogels se banta hai, bilkul shaffaf aur biocompatible hona chahiye taake nazar wapis aaye (Table 26.2).

book_ref.quote: Must be perfectly clear (transparent) and biocompatible to restore vision.

blocks.prompt:
100 In artificial skin, collagen and PLA act as:
(Artificial skin mein collagen aur PLA kya kaam karte hain?)

options.text: joint ki kam ragar wali satah
nayi jild ugne ke liye scaffold (dhaancha)

blocks.explanation: Collagen (natural) aur PLA (synthetic) nayi jild ugne ke liye scaffold (dhaancha) ka kaam karte hain; kuch zakhm bharne par ghul jate hain (Table 26.2).

book_ref.quote: Acts as a scaffold for new skin growth; some are designed to dissolve as the wound heals.
